strings.zh: 等等！{SCROLL}你已经参观过地鼠洞穴了吗？{SCROLL}其实进入洞穴可以到达２号道路。{CLEAR}很方便哦~
strings.en: Wait! Have you been to Diglett’s Cave{NEWLINE}yet?{SCROLL}Going through the cave actually takes{NEWLINE}you to Route 2. It’s really handy!

strings.zh: 我看到了哦！{NEWLINE}有一只金色的大鸟{CLEAR}从这里向北了过去。{SCROLL}那到底是什么鸟啊,会飞到哪呢？
strings.en: I saw it! A big golden bird flew off{NEWLINE}north from here.{SCROLL}What kind of bird was that? And where{NEWLINE}was it going?
